tutorialNudgeRunes: Runes are for later lessons — buy a Dwarf from the shop first.
tutorialNudgePlacePads: Move both Dwarves onto the glowing pads first (one must be rotated).
tutorialNudgeFinishPad: Finish placing on the glowing pad before buying another unit.
tutorialNudgeReadGoal: Click Next when you are ready to end deployment.
tutorialNudgeCameraFirst: Finish the camera lesson first — follow the on-screen steps.
tutorialNudgeRotate: Rotate this pack (press R or middle-click) to match the tall pad.
tutorial1GoalBody: The glowing frames mark each side’s life bar. Yours is on the left, the enemy’s on the right — bring theirs down to 0 to win. Each unit that survives the battle counts and reduces the enemy’s life bar.
tutorial1CamLeftBody: Slide the view to the left so you can see more of the field that way.
tutorial1CamRightBody: Now slide the view to the right.
tutorial1CamForwardBody: Push the view toward the middle of the battlefield.
tutorial1CamForwardTouch: Drag one finger toward the bottom of the screen
tutorial1CamBackBody: Pull the view back toward your side.
tutorial1CamBackTouch: Drag one finger toward the top of the screen
tutorial1CamOrbitBody: Orbit around the field so you can look from a new angle.
tutorial1CamOrbitTouch: Drag with three fingers left or right
tutorial1CamZoomBody: Zoom closer to the board — you will need this when placing packs.
tutorial1CamZoomOutBody: Zoom back out so you can see the whole field again.
tutorial1CamZoomOutMouse: Scroll wheel away from you (zoom out)
tutorial1Buy1Body: You have 200 supply — enough for two packs. Click the glowing Dwarf in the shop.
tutorial1Place1Body: Click your Dwarf twice to pick it up, then find the glowing pad on the map and click it to place the pack there.
tutorial1Buy2Body: Click the glowing Dwarf again. You will place this one differently.
tutorial1Place2Body: Move the second Dwarf onto the other pad, then rotate it — press R, middle-click, or use the Rotate button on touch — so it matches the tall footprint.
tutorial1EndBody: Press the glowing End Deployment button — the battle then runs automatically.
tutorial1R2Nudge: Finish the income steps first — place both Hammerers.
tutorial1R2IntroBody: You just received 400 supply because this is Round 2. Income grows every round: 200, then 400, then 600, then 800. Spend it before the battle starts.
tutorial1R2BuyHammererBody: Buy a Hammerer (100 supply) — medium-range splash that shreds packed Dwarves. 400 pays for two.
tutorial1R2PlaceHammererBody: Place it on the glowing pad.
tutorial1R2PlaceHammerer2Body: Place the second Hammerer on the other glowing pad.
tutorial1R2EndBody: Press End Deployment — four packed Dwarves walk into your splash.
tutorial1R3Nudge: Finish the closest-target steps first — place both packs, then read the tip.
tutorial1R3IntroBody: Packs have no fancy targeting — they always walk and shoot at the closest enemy. You can use that.
tutorial1R3BuyDwarfBody: Buy a Dwarf. It will stand in front and soak the enemy’s attention.
tutorial1R3PlaceDwarfBody: Place the Dwarf on the glowing front pad — closest to the enemy line.
tutorial1R3BuyArcherBody: Buy an Archer. It deals the real damage while the Dwarf draws fire.
tutorial1R3PlaceArcherBody: Place the Archer on the glowing pad — centered, two fields behind the Dwarf.
tutorial1R3ExplainBody: An enemy Archer stands in front of a Dwarf pack. They will dump into your closer Dwarf bait. Your Archer shoots their front Archer first while their firepower is wasted on the bait.
tutorial1R3EndBody: Press End Deployment — watch them shoot the wrong pack.
tutorial1R4Nudge: Place your Archer, then click both packs to compare range lines.
tutorial1R4IntroBody: Height stretches downhill range. A tiny ridge on your right is enough — stand on it and you out-range a pack on flat ground.
tutorial1R4BuyArcherBody: Buy an Archer to hold the knoll.
tutorial1R4PlaceArcherBody: Place the Archer on the glowing pad atop the ridge.
tutorial1R4SelectOwnBody: Click your Archer and look at the range lines — high ground stretches them downhill.
tutorial1R4SelectEnemyBody: Now click the enemy Archer. Compare the range lines.
tutorial1R4EndBody: This archer has lower range because he stands lower. Press End Deployment.
tutorial2NudgeFinishStep: Complete the current step before ending deployment.
tutorial2NudgeNoShop: This round uses your Stronghold only — no shop packs.
tutorial2R1IntroBody: This is your keep. If it falls, your whole army dies. Click it to open its panel.
tutorial2R1ArchersBody: Buy all {{slots}} archer slots on the battlements — they defend the keep during the battle.
tutorial2R1EndBody: Press End Deployment — the battle runs automatically. Your archers will hold the line.
tutorial2R2IntroBody: This round the enemy sends a bigger wave. Click your Stronghold — you will buy commander spells from it.
tutorial2R2BuyOilBody: Buy Oil Spill from your Stronghold — it slows enemies marching through the center.
tutorial2R2ArmOilBody: Click Oil Spill in your tactics strip to arm it.
tutorial2R2PlaceOilStartBody: Click the glowing circle on the left side of the center lane.
tutorial2R2PlaceOilEndBody: Click the glowing circle in the middle of the board to finish a left-to-center oil trail.
tutorial2R2BuyDragonBody: Buy Dragon Attack — it breathes fire across the lane and can ignite the oil.
tutorial2R2ArmDragonBody: Click Dragon Attack in your tactics strip to arm it.
tutorial2R2PlaceDragonStartBody: Click the glowing circle on the right side of the center lane.
tutorial2R2PlaceDragonEndBody: Click the glowing circle on the left to finish a full-length right-to-left dragon path.
tutorial2R2EndBody: Press End Deployment — watch the oil slow them and the dragon set the path ablaze.
tutorial2R3IntroBody: Both sides now have a Stronghold. Destroy the enemy keep and their entire army collapses — even if their packs are winning. Click your Stronghold to continue.
tutorial2R3UpgradeBody: Keep upgrading your Stronghold — click Upgrade in the top right corner of the Stronghold panel until it reaches level {{max}} (now {{level}}/{{max}}).
tutorial2R3BuySummonBody: Buy Summon Dwarves from your Stronghold — drop them behind the enemy keep.
tutorial2R3ArmSummonBody: Click Summon Dwarves in your tactics strip to arm it.
tutorial2R3PlaceSummonBody: Click the glowing circle on the right side behind the enemy Stronghold — their army is on the left, so your dwarves hit the keep from the rear.
tutorial2R3UpgradeNudge: Upgrade again — your keep is only level {{level}}/{{max}}.
tutorial2R3EndBody: Press End Deployment — if the enemy Stronghold falls, their whole army dies with it.
tutorial3NudgeReadIntro: Read the briefing and press Next first.
tutorial3NudgeNoShop: No packs this round — the lesson is on the panel to your right.
tutorial3NudgePlacePads: Put your Dwarves on the left pad and your Ballista on the right pad first.
tutorial3NudgeBoosts: Max both Vanguard boosts first — attack {{attack}}/{{max}}, HP {{hp}}/{{max}}.
tutorial3NudgeAttackFirst: Max the Army Attack Boost first — HP comes next.
tutorial3NudgeHpNext: Attack is done — buy the Army HP Boost now.
tutorial3NudgeDwarfOnly: Buy Dwarves for the glowing pads.
tutorial3NudgeGarrison: Open your Garrison first — finish the panel steps before buying packs.
tutorial3NudgeRecruit: Buy Veteran Training on your Garrison first.
tutorial3NudgeSlot: Open your Garrison again and buy +1 Deploy Slot first.
tutorial3NudgeDwarves: Place Level-2 Dwarves on the glowing pads first ({{filled}}/{{need}}).
tutorial3NudgeUpgrade: Upgrade your Garrison to level {{max}} first — it is level {{level}}.
tutorial3NudgeMortar: Buy and place the Mortar on the glowing pad first.
tutorial3R3IntroBody: The enemy fields two Level-2 Dwarf packs. Recruit at Level 2, place two packs, then buy a third deploy slot from your Garrison.
tutorial3R3SelectBody: Click your Garrison — the tower on your left — to open its panel.
tutorial3R3RecruitBody: Buy Veteran Training. For the rest of this round every pack you buy arrives at Level 2.
tutorial3R3BuyTwoBody: Buy Dwarves from the shop and place them on both glowing pads ({{filled}}/{{need}}). They spawn at Level 2.
tutorial3R3SelectAgainBody: Click your Garrison again — you will unlock one more deploy slot.
tutorial3R3SlotBody: Buy +1 Deploy Slot — one extra pack this round only.
tutorial3R3BuyThirdBody: Buy one more Dwarf and place it on the remaining glowing pad ({{filled}}/{{need}}).
tutorial3R3EndBody: Press End Deployment — three Level-2 packs against two should win the line.
tutorial3R4IntroBody: One Garrison. Enemy Dwarves will chew it. Upgrade the tower so it lasts, then a Mortar finishes them while they dig.
tutorial3R4SelectBody: Click your Garrison — the building on the left — to open its panel.
tutorial3R4UpgradeBody: Upgrade until it reaches level {{max}} (now {{level}}/{{max}}). More HP means they take longer to bring it down.
tutorial3R4BuyBody: Click the glowing Mortar in the shop — long-range artillery for packs stuck on your tower.
tutorial3R4PlaceBody: Place the Mortar on the glowing pad at the back of your zone, behind the Garrison.
tutorial3R4EndBody: Press End Deployment — the upgraded tower buys time while the Mortar crushes the melee.
tutorial4NudgeRune: Assign the highlighted rune to the glowing pack — arm it from your bag if needed.
tutorial4NudgeForge: Insert three Fire runes into your Stronghold forge until Fire III is ready.
tutorial4NudgeApply: Arm Fire III from your bag and click the glowing Ogre.
tutorial4NudgeLongbow: Buy Range on your Archers first — that is the only talent this round.
tutorial4R1IntroBody: A Dwarf and a Goblin stand locked in place — each has two rune slots. Buy each base rune, then assign it to the glowing pack.
tutorial4R1BuyfireBody: Buy Fire from the rune row. It adds attack.
tutorial4R1AssignfireBody: Assign Fire to the Goblin. It gives more attack.
tutorial4R1BuyearthBody: Buy Earth from the rune row. It adds HP.
tutorial4R1AssignearthBody: Assign Earth to the Dwarf. It gives more HP.
tutorial4R1BuywindBody: Buy Wind from the rune row. It adds range.
tutorial4R1AssignwindBody: Assign Wind to the Goblin. It increases range.
tutorial4R1BuywaterBody: Buy Water from the rune row. It adds speed.
tutorial4R1AssignwaterBody: Assign Water to the Dwarf. It increases speed.
tutorial4R1EndBody: Press End Deployment — your runed Dwarf and Goblin face bare mirrors.
tutorial4R2IntroBody: Your Stronghold can fuse runes. Three Fire in the oven bake into Fire III for the next deployment.
tutorial4R2SelectBody: Click your Stronghold to open it — you will feed the forge.
tutorial4R2ForgeBody: Buy Fire from the shop (it arms) and click the Stronghold to insert it. Do this until three Fires sit in the oven ({{n}}/{{need}}). The forge will produce {{product}} next round.
tutorial4R2EndBody: Press End Deployment — the oven resolves when the next deploy begins.
tutorial4R3IntroBody: The Stronghold oven finished — Fire III is ready, a stronger attack rune. Slot it onto your Ogre. The enemy fields a bare Ogre.
tutorial4R3ApplyBody: Arm Fire III from your bag (or it may already be armed) and click the glowing Ogre.
tutorial4R3EndBody: Press End Deployment — forged power against a bare Ogre.
tutorial4R4IntroBody: {{packs}} Archer packs stand in each side’s center — far enough apart that both lines must march before they can shoot. Range decides who fires first.
tutorial4R4SelectBody: Click any of your Archer packs to open its talent panel.
tutorial4R4LongbowBody: Buy the Range talent — it stretches every Archer pack’s range. That is the only purchase this round.
tutorial4R4EndBody: Press End Deployment — with the longer reach your Archers should open fire first and win the volley.
tutorial5NudgeHeight: Press End Deployment — high ground is your only edge this round.
tutorial5R1IntroBody: {{packs}} Archer packs stand on each side — same talents, same line. You are on a steep shelf; the enemy is downslope. Height stretches your downhill range.
tutorial5R1EndBody: Press End Deployment — watch the high line open fire first.
tutorial3R1IntroBody: Knock a tower down and that side’s units crawl, hit weaker, and take more damage.
tutorial3R1BuyDwarfBody: Click the glowing Dwarf in the shop — they will hold the left lane against the enemy packs.
tutorial3R1PlaceDwarfBody: Click the pack twice to pick it up, then click the glowing pad on the left so it meets the enemy Dwarves head-on.
tutorial3R1BuyBallistaBody: Click the glowing Ballista. It out-ranges everything on the field — perfect for an undefended tower.
tutorial3R1PlaceBallistaBody: Place the Ballista on the glowing pad on the right, where nothing stands between it and the enemy tower.
tutorial3R1DebuffBody: Your Dwarves pin their army on the left while the Ballista knocks down the tower nobody is guarding. The moment it falls their whole army reels — and your Dwarves win the lane they were losing.
tutorial3R1EndBody: Press End Deployment and watch the tower come down.
tutorial3R2IntroBody: Identical armies — the only thing that can decide it is what you buy from your Vanguard.
tutorial3R2SelectBody: Click your Vanguard — the tower on your right — to open its panel.
tutorial3R2AttackBody: Buy the Army Attack Boost until it is maxed ({{tier}}/{{max}}). Every tier is permanent and applies to your whole army for the rest of the match.
tutorial3R2HpBody: Now buy the Army HP Boost to the top ({{tier}}/{{max}}). Tougher packs survive long enough for the extra damage to matter.
tutorial3R2EndBody: Press End Deployment — the same pack, boosted twice over, should walk through theirs.
